title: Remote viewing continued under OSAP

tellings.quote: on. And I mean, you even if you read skim marketers at the Pentagon, it was definitely still going on in the context of Osap

plain: Remote viewing is the practice of trying to see distant places or things with the mind alone. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that even a skim of Skinwalkers at the Pentagon, a book about a Pentagon-funded UFO research effort, shows remote viewing work was still going on after 1995 as part of OSAP, one of those government study programmes.
